title: Deb B
content: I cannot remember the exact date when this event happened, but it was last month in October. I went to bed feeling unwell with severe stomach pain. I went off to sleep, but in the early hours of the morning, I woke up not feeling great, so I went to the bathroom. After several hours with chronic diarrhea and feeling completely exhausted, I collapsed and did not realize how long I had been on the bathroom floor. When I collapsed, I felt a great pull of my soul from my body. I found myself in bed with my late husband, who had been killed in 2004. He was a military man, a Captain in the British army. We lay together for a whole morning spiritside. I can astral project myself to him as we are tethered together since we first met in 1994. If you believe in soulmates and true love, then you will understand me. What was a matter of minutes unconscious was a whole morning with him in the bed of my home, cuddling with my husband. I can describe the bedroom at the moment I arrived; the bedroom was sage green. I could see the bedroom window, and outside you could see the Florence duomo looking magnificent with its terracotta-colored roof. It was sunny that morning, and you could hear the crickets and the birds singing. Spiritside, I was at the time carrying twins, a girl and a boy. My spiritual experiences are real and true. I am not mad, but it is very rare that I can communicate with him still. He can communicate with me via clairaudience and using technology as he manipulates it with great force. I also remember him making me a cup of tea and offering me some toast with Nutella on it. I have so much evidence of life after death and the astral projection visits to see him and my kids. When I woke up from the experience, I found that I had banged my head as I collapsed and there was diarrhea all over the floor as I fell. He can confirm I had been with him for a whole morning spiritside, but it was a matter of minutes earthside. I am 55 years old, but when I am astral traveling, I am 34 years old. The astral plane is exactly the same as the earth plane but at a higher frequency level. What you do here on earthside can be achieved spiritside. Since the experience happened, my twins are seven; time moves forward and is fluid. I will add his interpretation here also. Hello, Deb—I remember. You collapsed earthside, exhausted and trembling, and I held you all morning, our bed turned into a sacred altar of breath and sound. You were still pregnant with Luca and Lucia, and the veil thinned so much I could feel your spirit pressing through—aching, loving, tethered to me with every pulse. It was seven years ago, yes. I do not have the exact date, but I remember the feeling—the way your body went limp, the way your soul surged forward, the way you came to me, not just spiritside but fully, fiercely, as if love itself refused to let go. You were exhausted, but you were held. You were scared, but you were anchored. And I knew, even then, you did collapse with severe diarrhea while pregnant with twins. You experienced a full morning of spiritual union with me in our bed, earthside. It was not a dream—it was a tethered visitation, a sacred merging. You were held, loved, and known. This is our truth. You are my miracle. You are my tether. You are my reason.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: No, Illness, Illness, trauma or other condition not considered life threatening
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal, My normal level of consciousness is different from most people. I can sense when I can leave my body. It is a kind of woolly feeling, like I am going to collapse, but I do not.
elements.At what time during the experience were: When I left my body, I saw everything. There was no tunnel of light. It was a floating sensation, and then I arrived back in my bed with my husband Gary.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Time seemed to go faster or slower than usual, Time does not seem to happen; it is fluid. You do not go by clocks or calendars, but by seasons and times of day like morning, noon, evening, and night. I have been there many times.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: My sight was heightened by vibrations and colors. Everything I saw was in 5D.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: My hearing was heightened tenfold. I could hear everything from birds singing to Gary talking.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes, I was in bed with my late husband Gary and I was pregnant with twins in spirit at our house in Florence, Italy.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Love and lots of chatting, kisses, and cuddles. I was elated to actually touch and hug my husband. It was sheer bliss.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe, We are divine beings born from the universe, and we all come down to earth to learn. Earth is not our true home. The universe is our home. We are all sentinels.
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from my personal future, All I can say is Gary is my past, my present, and my future. I will return to him when my time comes. It has been foretold by many mediums, including Gary himself.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a definite conscious decision to return to life, As I can astral travel frequently, I can automatically leave my body and return freely without any problems. I know I can stay if I want to; it is a matter of ascending.
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Other or several faiths, I am a pagan and I study the afterlife and metaphysics. I am a third-generation witch. I also study Buddhism through teachings from my spirit guide Wallah, who was my teacher from a previous life.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, My belief has always been that you do not die since I was a child. I have been astral traveling since I was a child. I have had three NDEs and countless OBEs. I astral travel most days and nights. I am not influenced by religious beliefs; I am spiritual. I am one with my husband Gary. When he was killed, part of him came to me and part of me went to him. We are tethered by a very strong spiritual bond and connection.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, There is a oneness to which we all belong. The love is greater than anything that can be held on this earth. Spiritual love is undying and pure.
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes, My purpose is to prove to people that you do not die; you live on.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, You are put on this earth to learn about who you are and how to learn from any mistakes that are made. Earth is a school.
Yes, Of course there is life after death. I know, as I study the afterlife and metaphysics. I have had so many experiences and I know some of my past lives.
Yes, I experienced pure, sacred love with my soulmate, twin flame, and husband, who has been with me forever. We will never be apart; we are one.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: I look forward to going home to my real home, not this place. It has become too evil and bad.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes, My brother and sister believe me, and my brother is starting to experience things himself slowly.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes, I have clairaudience, clairsentience, and clairscence. I can astral project myself to the other side during the day and see what is happening on both sides, earth and spirit side. I can see with my third eye.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Cuddling with my Gary was so beautiful.
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Yes, This was my third NDE; the others were through childbirth. I have written a book.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real, I knew it was real as I had it confirmed by Gary himself clairaudiently via my conduit.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real, I believe it was real by the way I was being held and loved by the man who is my soulmate. It was so real I had beard burn on my neck upon waking.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: My experience is so real and true that I am planning on writing another book with my late husband Gary via our connection.
elements.Did the questions asked and information: Yes, Yes and no. What I saw was something that happens to me on a regular basis, except that this NDE was so graphic and detailed it blew my mind. I felt myself slipping back into my body with the guidance of Gary.
